clue.text: The trial of a royal household Roman poet

parts.note: a monarch's household and attendants are the court
Martial was a Latin poet famous for his epigrams

explanation.surface: A trial held by a monarch's staff concerning a Roman writer.
explanation.definitionFit: A military tribunal trying service personnel is a kind of trial.

clue.text: Distributor supplying vital capital requirements

parts.note: capital means the head, not money: this is a vessel carrying blood up the neck to the head

explanation.surface: A firm handing out essential funds for a city's needs.
explanation.definitionFit: The main artery of the neck delivers blood, the head's vital requirement.

clue.text: American lady who puts people in their place!

definitions.text: who puts people in their place!

parts.note: a lady is referred to as her

explanation.surface: An American woman who is fond of telling people off.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre or church attendant shows each person to their seat.

clue.text: Send for a taxi?

definitions.meaning: to send is to convey or carry away, in the old sense of deporting
a cab is one example of a means of carriage

explanation.definitionFit: Both the verb to convey and the noun for vehicles that carry people share this word.

clue.text: Over and above what local sources can provide

indicators.note: the run of words supplies, within itself, the letters needed

explanation.surface: Something extra beyond what nearby suppliers can offer.
explanation.definitionFit: Over and above means in addition, a synonym.

clue.text: Without trouble, piece of furniture can be turned over

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the furniture goes round the trouble

parts.note: a table is a piece of furniture
ill means trouble or harm

explanation.surface: A piece of furniture that can be flipped without difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' reads as 'free of', but here it carries its old meaning of outside, as in the hymn's 'a green hill far away, without a city wall'.
explanation.definitionFit: Land that can be ploughed, its soil turned over, is arable.

clue.text: A period of bad health makes one concerned

parts.note: a bout is a spell of illness, such as a bout of flu

explanation.surface: Falling ill for a while leaves someone worried.
explanation.definitionFit: Concerned with a matter is being on that subject, a near synonym of regarding.

clue.text: Sort of dope to secure for an Indian get-together

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis, a kind of dope
to latch a door is to fasten it

explanation.surface: Bringing a type of drug to an Indian gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: A ceremonial feast of Pacific Northwest Native American peoples, with gift-giving.

clue.text: A heavenly body from remote parts

indicators.note: the word is split into parts and reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: A celestial object arriving from distant regions of space.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parts' looks like regions, as in 'remote parts', but signals rearranging REMOTE.
explanation.definitionFit: A shooting star is an object from space, loosely called a heavenly body.

clue.text: Listens in sure enough for practice

indicators.note: one word is placed inside the other

parts.note: real means genuine, sure enough
hears means listens

explanation.surface: Someone who listens closely is certainly practising.
explanation.definitionFit: A run-through before a performance is a practice session.

clue.text: Gas ring location

parts.note: a ring is shaped like the letter O
a zone is an area or location

explanation.surface: Where a gas ring on a stove is found.
explanation.definitionFit: A form of oxygen with three atoms is a gas.

clue.text: A flight creature's infantile complaint

definitions.meaning: a songbird, a creature that flies
a fungal infection common in babies' mouths

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a songbird and a yeast infection that affects infants.

clue.text: Having done badly, the egghead is sweet

parts.note: past means over, finished
ill means badly, as in ill-treated
the head, or first letter, of egg

explanation.surface: After a poor performance, the intellectual is pleasant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egghead' looks like an intellectual but gives just the first letter of 'egg'.
explanation.definitionFit: A small lozenge is a type of sweet.

clue.text: Fruit will be provided when mothers take over

parts.note: dams are animal mothers
on can mean over, as a cover is on or over something

explanation.surface: Fruit appears when the mothers step in.
explanation.definitionFit: A small dark plum is a fruit.

clue.text: It's a fruit, thar's official

definitions.meaning: a small citrus fruit like a tangerine

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a small orange and an imperial Chinese bureaucrat.

clue.text: The fellow's second-rate — of less significance

definitions.note: the definition is The fellow, with 's standing for is

parts.note: B is the grade below A, second-rate
lighter means less weighty, less important

explanation.surface: The man is mediocre and matters less.
explanation.definitionFit: A mildly contemptuous British term for a chap or person.

clue.text: Duck or look over

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold, so golden
to eye something is to look it over

explanation.surface: Either crouch down or give something a glance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' looks like a link but is the heraldic term for gold.
explanation.definitionFit: A diving sea duck with a yellow iris is named for its eye.

clue.text: He figures well as an American cowboy

definitions.meaning: a Cambridge student gaining first-class honours in mathematics
a ranch hand who herds horses

explanation.definitionFit: The title for a top Cambridge maths graduate is also a horse-herding ranch hand.

clue.text: Threatening many, or it may appear so

indicators.note: the letters may appear in another order

explanation.surface: Menacing to lots of people, or so it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: Menacing is a synonym of threatening.

clue.text: Feel the lack of a cash book

parts.note: to miss someone is to feel their absence
L stands for pounds, money

explanation.surface: Missing an account book for money.
explanation.definitionFit: A prayer book containing the Mass texts is a liturgical book.

clue.text: The place of the obsolescent radio enthusiast

parts.note: old means outdated
a ham is an amateur radio operator

explanation.surface: Where an outdated wireless hobbyist lives.
explanation.definitionFit: A town in Greater Manchester, England, is a place.

clue.text: Little beast accounts for half Grahame's friends

parts.note: Mole and Rat are two of the four friends in Kenneth Grahame's The Wind in the Willows, along with Toad and Badger
Mole and Rat are two of the four friends in Kenneth Grahame's The Wind in the Willows, along with Toad and Badger

explanation.surface: A small animal makes up half of an author's circle of pals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accounts for half' tells you two of Grahame's four animal friends are needed.
explanation.definitionFit: A burrowing African rodent is a small animal.

clue.text: Give voice about the whip cutting

indicators.note: one word goes around the other

parts.note: to sing is to give voice
to lash is to whip

explanation.surface: Shouting about the whip as it slices.
explanation.definitionFit: Slashing means cutting with sweeping strokes.

clue.text: A charming woman gives time to one

parts.note: an hour is a unit of time
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An attractive lady devotes time to someone.
explanation.definitionFit: In Islamic belief, a beautiful maiden of paradise, so an alluring woman.

clue.text: Used to drive a car

parts.note: read as fuel that powers a vehicle, not someone who once drove

explanation.definitionFit: Motor fuel is what powers a car's engine.

clue.text: Gun fire scattered about fifty

indicators.note: one part goes round the other
the letters of the word are scattered into a new order

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Gunshots spray across about fifty targets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scattered' turns FIRE into RIFE; 'about' puts it around L.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-barrelled firearm is a gun.

clue.text: Food served very high

parts.note: so means very
up means high

explanation.surface: Food served on a high shelf.
explanation.definitionFit: A liquid dish is a kind of food.

clue.text: Leaving word for a Frenchman

parts.note: the farewell a Frenchman would say on departing

explanation.definitionFit: The French farewell is a goodbye.

clue.text: Expected to be sought out

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both anticipated and searched for.

clue.text: To give a false account may make men repress it

indicators.note: the letters may make a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Lying can make men suppress things.
explanation.definitionFit: Misrepresent means to distort or report falsely.
